simple.meaning: קְטַל (qᵉṭal) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to kill.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 7 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:13. The surrounding contexts include death, commandment, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְטַל (H6992) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קְטַל (qᵉṭal) / H6992 is traced through Daniel 2:13, Daniel 2:14, Daniel 3:22, Daniel 5:19 with source-language evidence and verse context.
